description: Overrides the project's breathing strength for as long as it lasts. Draws nothing; it only changes how deeply the frame moves. Use it to open a section up or to hold a section still without switching the effect off everywhere.

fields.name: strength
fields.label: Strength
fields.description: How deep the breath is over this stretch. The tempo never changes; every strength shares one clock so the footage and the graphics stay in step.
